summary: This short wiki note covers the education and early career of Richard Rakowski. It states that he graduated from Lehman College in 1973 with a bachelor's degree in political science. It also notes that he then served as a Rotary Foundation ambassador of good will in Germany, where he studied the Holocaust.
one_line: Richard Rakowski's education at Lehman College and his Rotary Foundation goodwill ambassadorship in Germany studying the Holocaust.
key_facts: Richard Rakowski graduated from Lehman College in 1973.
Richard Rakowski earned a bachelor's degree in political science.
After graduating, Richard Rakowski served as a Rotary Foundation ambassador of good will in Germany.
During his Rotary Foundation ambassadorship in Germany, Richard Rakowski studied the Holocaust.
